title: DuoMind: Enabling Distributed Multi-Robot Coordination with Semantic Communication
abstract: arXiv:2610.02161v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) and vision-language-action models (VLAs) have recently driven rapid progress in general-purpose robots, yet most progress has focused on single-robot settings. Extending these capabilities to multi-robot systems remains challenging because robots must coordinate long-horizon behaviors while maintaining reliable, fine-grained execution. We introduce DuoMind, a distributed hierarchical framework for multi-robot coordination through semantic communication. Each robot uses a VLA-based action model for low-level execution and a VLM-based orchestrator for high-level reasoning and inter-agent coordination. At each planning step, the orchestrator at each robot reasons over the task instruction, local observations, and messages received from other robots. translated_title: DuoMind：基于语义通信实现分布式多机器人协同
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）和视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）近来推动了通用机器人的快速发展，然而大多数进展都集中在单机器人场景。将这些能力扩展到多机器人系统仍然具有挑战性，因为机器人必须在协调长时程行为的同时保持可靠、细粒度的执行。我们提出了DuoMind，一个通过语义通信实现多机器人协同的分布式分层框架。每个机器人使用基于VLA的动作模型进行底层执行，并使用基于VLM的编排器进行高层推理和智能体间协调。在每个规划步骤中，每个机器人上的编排器会对任务指令、本地观测以及从其他机器人接收到的消息进行推理，然后为动作模型生成底层指令，并向同伴机器人发送语义消息。该架构充分利用了预训练模型的优势互补……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: DuoMind提出了一个分布式分层多机器人协同框架，每台机器人结合基于VLA的动作模型进行底层执行、基于VLM的编排器进行高层推理，并通过语义通信实现机器人间的协调。
en_tdlr: DuoMind is a distributed hierarchical framework for multi-robot coordination that pairs a VLA-based action model for low-level execution with a VLM-based orchestrator for high-level reasoning, enabling inter-robot coordination through semantic communication.
